name: web-today-release-press-kit-landing-page-red-coffee-illustration
title: 'Today Release' press kit landing page in red with a flat-illustrated coffee cup and phone mockup
whatItIs: A red landing page with a left nav (Home, News, Categories, About Us), a boxed 'TODAY RELEASE' headline, 'Coffee Shops Everywhere' subtitle, a phone mockup showing an order app, a flat-illustrated coffee cup with splashing coffee, body copy, 'Read more' and 'Register here' buttons, and a flat-illustrated woman with a quote.
whatItMeans: Warm and newsy; framing a product launch as a 'press release' landing page gives it instant credibility and urgency.
techniques: Frame an announcement page like a news release.
Pair a product screen mockup with a matching flat illustration.
Include a customer quote for social proof directly on the landing page.

vocabulary.definition: A landing page framed as an official announcement or news release.
A short testimonial used as social proof.
